text:
sara: linkchecker flagged a bunch of 404s after the docs migration, looks like anchor collisions in /reference/ and /how-to/ pages.

ci-bot: linkcheck job #112 failed
```
Error: Duplicate slug 'install' detected in /reference/installation.md and /reference/overview.md
Docusaurus: failed to build: anchor collision
```

kevin: hmm. This usually happens when we both have explicit ids (e.g. `{#install}`) and the mdx slugify also emits `install` from an H2. Did the new remark plugin start emitting explicit ids?

sara: yes, the migration added `{#install}` in several places to keep back-compat. we should prefer explicit admonition ids vs implicit heading slugs.

kevin: plan: (1) remove inline explicit ids from headings and use admonition IDs for notes, (2) add a temporary client-side redirect in `static/js/anchors.js` to map old anchors, (3) update the SDK snippet (was `import { Redwood } from 'redwood-sdk'` -> now `import { InferenceClient } from '@redwood/inference-client'`) and a small code sample change.

leo: can you do a tiny PR for (1)+(3) and I'll handle the redirect in a separate PR? keeps diffs small.

kevin: opened PR https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/8210 with fixes: removed heading ids, updated SDK examples, added codeblock language tags. PTAL @sara @leo

sara: nit: please add a revertable comment near the removed ids so translators know why we regenerated slugs.

localization-bot: note: locales/fr/reference/installation.md still has `{#install}` — will need slug regen after merge.

ci-bot: preview build for PR #8210 started (netlify job 439)

ci-bot: preview build failed: static/js/anchors.js not found (merge conflict with master)

leo: ok I'll rebase the redirect PR after #8210 merges.

kevin: CI green on main once tests ran, netlify preview now passing. comment left: "please run locale-slug regen (cc @localization-bot)"

ci-bot: netlify: Build succeeded for PR #8210. Linkcheck scheduled nightly.

sara: merging now. @localization-bot run the slug regen and then ping here with linkcheck results

localization-bot: started slug regen job; ETA 20m

localization-bot: slug regen complete — updated 12 locale files, opened PR https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/8211

ci-bot: nightly linkcheck: all green. no anchor collisions detected.

leo: great, followup: I'll add a unit test to docs-build that asserts no duplicate slugs within a directory.

sara: thanks team, saved us a production outage. :tada:
